rankedLeadSummary: 1. Ibrahim Alfa Jnr — Subutrax: freehand polyrhythmic footwork pressure whose barline keeps changing under attention.
2. Leo — Jetti: reduced electro snap, dubwise chords and precision syncopation as continuation rather than full transformation.
3. Jeff Mills — Electromagnetic: overlooked half-time mechanical bob that changes bodily posture without requiring a climax.
4. Ibrahim Alfa Jnr — Ikoyi: break fragments gradually slipping into ambient dub without an obvious stable destination.
5. Planetary Assault Systems — The 808 Track (Parts 1 and 2): hyperactive, direct drums made strange by surrounding vacancy.
6. Ibrahim Alfa Jnr — Drum Slinger (Other Version): clarinet and manipulated djembe attacks wriggling around bass.
7. Jeff Mills — The Tides: strings, woody syncopated percussion and an agile bassline moving together.
8. Leo — Spirit Level (Prescript): an extended bass-and-chirp headfake that refuses a conventional kick arrival.
9. HVL — Raining Birds: current rolling-breakbeat techno from a release built around dub bass, acid and club-functional surprise.
